newsitem.title: ITALY: Minimum rate 7.43 pct at Italy lira repo tender.
newsitem.headline: Minimum rate 7.43 pct at Italy lira repo tender.

text.p: The minimum rate at today's 7.5 trillion lire 28-day Bank of Italy repurchase tender was 7.43 percent, compared with 7.21 percent at the previous repo tender on January 24, the Bank said.
The average rate was 7.46 percent against 7.29 percent at the last repurchase pact for 16.0 trillion lire and 28 days.
The pact covers purchases today and tomorrow and the securities are for resale on March 3. The Bank said it received 48 bids of which 19 were met in full and eight in part.
